title: [3.x] Can't compile windows size-optimized release template with LTO

milestone.title: 3.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 3 release.

body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible:
- **3.x** a117d512b00f1646db174e703e7e888519b64608
- **3.6** da1b2b5d5727a63ff5e2a3a5a43c4c8b98dc64a0

Not Reproducible:
- **3.5** 8ec5e74eab66887589964bbd8723a3447d1d3a6f
- **3.4** cdeac0135350d95aa07a98388a45493a5950a8b4
- **3.3** a14db2f7450ec81ef40dd376150501ec5bee41eb

### System information

Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS, g++ (Ubuntu 13.3.0-6ubuntu2~24.04) 13.3.0

### Issue description

Tried to compile windows release-template in Ubuntu with command:
```console
scons platform=windows target=release lto=full tools=no debug_symbols=no optimize=size
```

Debug template compiles with a lot of warnings, but release template fails with errors:

### Steps to reproduce

1. switch to 3.x upstream
```
git pull --rebase upstream 3.x
```
2. run command
```
scons platform=windows target=release lto=full tools=no debug_symbols=no optimize=size
```
